title: Ui icons: This module provides a user interface to select and configure icons, including a CKEditor 5 button and widget that embed an icon in formatted text. (CVE-2026-114532)
description: The Drupal UI Icons module includes a CKEditor 5 button and widget that embed icons in formatted text. Under uncommon conditions, the widget can display admin-controlled text with insufficient filtering, leading to a Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. Exploitation requires the attacker to have permission to edit content using a text format that enables the UI Icons CKEditor 5 button. Patches are available for affected versions.
aiSummary: The UI Icons module for Drupal provides a user interface to select and configure icons, including integration with CKEditor 5. A Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists when the CKEditor 5 widget displays admin-controlled text without adequate filtering under uncommon conditions. This vulnerability requires the attacker to have content editing permissions with a text format that allows the UI Icons CKEditor 5 button. The affected versions are prior to 1.1.3 and versions from 2.0.0 up to but not including 2.0.2. A patch is available to address this issue.
aiImpact: Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker with content editing permissions to inject malicious scripts via the CKEditor 5 widget, potentially leading to XSS attacks. However, the requirement for editing privileges and specific text format usage limits the scope of impact.
